# 13cabs artwork source

`13cabs.svg` is the unmodified vector asset `13cabs_logo_only__PMS-151C_.svg` from the public 13cabs dispatch documentation repository at commit `fc1ff3258b0dfb6110b2c45cd8720a68a5650f3e`:

https://github.com/mizzi-sesh/13cabs-dva-download-guide/blob/fc1ff3258b0dfb6110b2c45cd8720a68a5650f3e/public/branding/13cabs_logo_only__PMS-151C_.svg

The associated navigation component imports this asset as the 13cabs brand logo. It is used solely to identify the selected taxi provider in this prototype. The 13cabs trademark remains the property of its owner; this source does not grant trademark rights or imply endorsement.

Official brand reference and media assets: https://www.13cabs.com.au/media-assets/
